svg.title: Peak timing and allocation geometry are different questions
svg.desc: Synthetic calculations specify expected accounting; they are not hardware measurements
svg.text: Peak timing and allocation geometry are different questions
Synthetic calculations specify expected accounting; they are not hardware measurements
Follow the same timeline for every component
Prefill activation maximum and decode workspace maximum do not coincide.
Simultaneous allocated peak: 712 MiB; sum of separate maxima: 776 MiB.
Separate closure, completion, slot return and backing release
A cancelled owner may leave an outstanding reader; outer cache can remain reserved.
After known drain: 2 MiB retained KV inside a still-backed 16 MiB pool.
Internal fragmentation: unused positions inside assigned blocks
Private lengths 1, 17 and 33 contain 6.375 MiB of valid payload.
B = 8, 16, 32 → assigned block bytes = 9, 12, 16 MiB; metadata is additional.
External constraints: enough total free bytes can still fail
Three separate 2 MiB holes cannot supply one contiguous 3 MiB allocation.
Two 2 MiB pages can hold it only through a compatible paged-storage interface.
Capture event peaks and scoped counters. Polling alone can miss a short-lived allocation.
